output.target: Whether the disorder reported in the second case (patient with upper-body pain and swelling, and a tissue-sampling procedure two months earlier) is stiff person syndrome.

subject.description: The case report in the 2010s involving an individual who presented with upper-body pain and swelling, had a tissue-sampling procedure two months earlier, and earlier developed stiffness followed by swelling four years later.

required_background.statement: There were two cases in different years reported in the 2010s.
One of the cases involved an individual who presented with complaints of pain and swelling in the upper part of the body.
In that case, a procedure involving the collection of tissue samples to test for disease had been performed two months earlier.
In that case, the individual had developed stiffness when younger, followed by swelling four years later.
The two cases covered a particular disorder shared between two individuals.
